About the Public Health event

Public Health is a Emergency Preparedness event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation · online submission.

Ten in-depth lessons for the HOSA Public Health team event and its 2026–27 topic, “Fact-Check Your Feed: Taking Down Health Myths Before They Spread.” Covers public health and the 10 Essential Services, health misinformation and the infodemic, why myths spread, fact-checking with SIFT and lateral reading, debunking and prebunking, planning the live community presentation, the three-minute Round One trailer (90 points), the Required Display Time and the ten-minute Round Two presentation (115 points). Built around the Surgeon General’s advisory on health misinformation, WHO, HHS and peer-reviewed research, with evidence-reading labs, bias and red-flag sorting, SIFT and truth-sandwich sequencing and scenario practice. All example posts are invented for practice.
